description: Low-resolution cropped photograph of Senator John McCain posing outdoors with a man in a striped shirt and a woman in a headscarf and pink blazer. It matches widely circulated images from McCain's May 2013 visit to Syria, where he met Free Syrian Army figures; versions of this photo circulated online with contested captions claiming to identify the other people, claims which have been disputed.
flags: Only McCain is confidently identified; the other two individuals are not identified from the image itself

description: Screenshot of a Breaking911 tweet dated March 5, 2019, reporting that security was stepped up in New York City after three small bombs were found near London transit hubs, citing WNBC. The tweet quotes an earlier Breaking911 tweet about IEDs found in packages at major London transit hubs.

description: The 8chan logo: a green infinity symbol whose ends form hooked, leaf-like tips, with the word 'chan' in black lowercase text below the right loop, on a white background.

Cartoon artwork of Lion-O from the animated series ThunderCats, standing with the Sword of Omens raised vertically in both hands in front of the red circular ThunderCats emblem (a black stylized cat-head silhouette on a red disc), on a black background.

Photograph of a display shelf promoting Ghidra, the NSA's open-source reverse-engineering tool, with 'NSA.GOV/GHIDRA' printed in green on a white banner. On the left is a round sticker with a red dragon-head logo reading 'IntelligenceCareers.gov/NSA'; on the right is a sticker of the Ghidra logo, a red dragon coiled into a figure-eight/infinity shape above the word 'GHIDRA'. The setting is consistent with a conference booth display.
